A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 3.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the reaction temperature is 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The cell operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 98% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Li6PS5X sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed bromine-iodine substitution and lithium battery
abstract: A Li6PS5X solid electrolyte represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and a method for producing the same are described. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiBr relative to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.15 or less. A precursor of the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3PS4 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 5.1 mS/cm. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The material comprises Li7P3S11, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4, wherein the Li6PS5X crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, bromine, and iodine. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyethylene oxide. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Densified garnet oxide ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 95% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. In an embodiment the material is Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1230 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm and a relative density of 95%. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. A sintering aid comprising LiF is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.11 <= v <= 0.8, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 1030 degrees C to 1380 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 10 mol% to 30 mol%.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material lithium sulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a zinc-containing additive layer
abstract: A lithium metal interface with uniform nucleation and suppressed dendrite penetration along grain boundaries is described. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LLZO, Li3PS4, and LiF material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. With the additive in an amount of 1 wt% and a stack pressure of 5 MPa, the Coulombic efficiency is 99.3%. The additive comprises zinc in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and lithium fluoride (LiF). The zinc additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. A dry process is preferred for forming the solid electrolyte sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 98.8% or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.4 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARHC INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARHC INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using an indium-containing additive layer
abstract: Provided is a solid-state cell in which indium is added at the lithium metal interface in an amount of 2 wt% to 10 wt% to suppress dendrites. A solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved interfacial resistance. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The additive comprises indium in an amount of 2 wt% to 10 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. The plating overpotential is 30 mV or less and the Coulombic efficiency is 99.5% after 100 cycles. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the electronic conductivity of the ceramic ion conductor layer is 1 x 10^-9 S/cm or less to prevent lithium deposition inside the layer. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.4 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 250 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium indium chloride coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li3InCl6 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The ion-conductive solid may comprise lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. The average thickness of the coating is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, the coverage is 75% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 80 mol% or more of the transition metals. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the all-solid-state lithium battery. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 80%. The high coverage of the coating results in improved interfacial resistance at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 15% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria with a thickness of 8 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite ceramic ion conductor in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. Firing is performed at 520 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LGPS and Li6PS5Cl material. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Lithium indium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium indium chloride and to a method for producing the same. A halide coating layer may be used together with the solid electrolyte to improve the cycle life of the solid-state battery. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3InCl6, Li6PS5Cl, and LiNbO3 material. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. Suitable compositions include Li3InCl6, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). A coverage of 80% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 30%. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The material comprises Li3InCl6, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The lithium indium chloride shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the electrochemical window and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using 1,2-dimethoxyethane and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to give a sulfide solid electrolyte precursor. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO, Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11 material. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved sinterability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a ceramic ion conductor is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The binder content of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% gives a peel strength of 0.1 N/cm or more and a conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. Specific examples are Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. Because the binder is dissolved in the solvent, the layer is uniform and shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 25 wt% to 70 wt%, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 40 degrees C to 140 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising nickel sulfide and graphene and lithium secondary battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 2 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of oxygen concentration at 700 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of oxygen.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

assignee_raw: Qilunhe New Energy Technology CO., LTD.
title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The warm isostatic pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 15 mol%. An all-solid-state battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ion-conductive solid shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The dopant gallium occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.35 to 0.7, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. A lithium excess of 15 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The LLZO and LATP material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1100 degrees C shows a conductivity of 1 mS/cm and a relative density of 95%. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 10 mol% to 30 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 900 degrees C to 1250 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite ion-conductive solid whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. Firing is performed at 550 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li7P3S11 and LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The material is useful as an ion-conductive solid layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.15 <= y/a <= 0.45, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The warm isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The capacity retention of 92% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without 1,3-propane sultone. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone is also described. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Lithium yttrium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and method for preparing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li3YCl6 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. The average thickness of the coating is 6 nm to 30 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium yttrium chloride, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The composition further comprises a lithium metal halide in which the chloride anion sublattice is close-packed, and the halide is synthesized together with the main phase. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A lithium secondary battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ceramic ion conductor shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The high coverage of the coating results in improved cycle life at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.5 nm to 75 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

assignee_db_group: DRIENZ UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a thio-LISICON phase and method for preparing the same
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a solid electrolyte of high conductivity. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li2ZrO3 and LiNbO3 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The content of P2O5 is 8 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.8 mS/cm or more. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3 and LiNbO3 material. Crystallization is performed at 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 4 hours, which precipitates a thio-LISICON phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. Suitable compositions include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the interfacial resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 100%.

title: Tantalum-doped garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body with high relative density
abstract: Disclosed is a method for sintering a tantalum-doped Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet to a relative density of 92% or more while suppressing lithium volatilization. The lithium secondary battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer. The dopant tantalum occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.35 to 0.7, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. Suitable compositions include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The grain size is 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and the relative density is 92% or more after sintering at 1020 degrees C to 1170 degrees C. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3 and LLTO material. The method gives reproducible densification and improved grain boundary resistance and sinterability at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a relative density of 92% or more.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. The positive electrode mixture may contain a solid electrolyte such as Li3PS4 as an ion-conducting additive. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, graphene, and polyacrylic acid is described. The confinement of nickel sulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the nickel sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the nickel sulfide cathode. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, graphene, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Bromine-substituted Li6PS5X solid electrolyte and lithium battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the Li6PS5X family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. A mixed-halogen Li6PS5X phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 450 degrees C. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li7P3S11 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.05, and the room-temperature conductivity is 6 mS/cm. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3InCl6 and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 85% or more and an average thickness of 2 nm to 10 nm is provided. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. A halide coating is compatible with the ion-conductive solid because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and nickel content of 75 mol% or more. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 70% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.5 nm to 25 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 25% or more.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The sensor shows a response time of 5 seconds to a step change of carbon dioxide concentration at 700 degrees C. The carbon dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Solvent-free free-standing solid electrolyte sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a roll-pressing method for forming a solid electrolyte film without any solvent. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A dry process is preferred for forming the solid electrolyte sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. The sheet thickness is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers, the porosity is 20% or less, and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm or more. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The solvent-free sheet avoids the conductivity loss caused by polar solvents and improves the cycle life and sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyethylene oxide matrix. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type solid electrolyte in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.12 or less. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. An ionic conductivity of 8.4 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.4 to 0.85. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. Suitable compositions include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), Li7P3S11, and beta-Li3PS4. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 8.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium iron phosphate, and a conductive agent. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C. The sensor shows a response time of 10 seconds to a step change of oxygen concentration at 500 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 500 degrees C. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. A lithium ion conducting glass may be used as the ceramic for a carbon dioxide sensor with a lithium carbonate auxiliary electrode. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 500 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects oxygen.

title: Halide ceramic ion conductor having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: A halide ceramic ion conductor comprises an orthorhombic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The median particle diameter D50 is 0.5 micrometers and the pellet conductivity is 1.2 mS/cm after pressing at 300 MPa. The material is also used as a coating layer on core particles of a nickel-rich positive electrode active material, with a coverage of 85% or more and a thickness of 5 nm to 20 nm. The halide phase is free of a LiCl secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. The orthorhombic phase is obtained by heat treatment at 200 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. The hafnium substitution lowers the raw material cost of the rare earth halide and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of barium carbonate that converts the ammonia concentration into an ionic activity. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of ammonia concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 470 microfarad rating. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 10 V.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 600 to 750 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 450 degrees C. When fired at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 8.4 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 8.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less.

title: Composite cathode comprising titanium disulfide and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The titanium disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The titanium disulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising titanium disulfide, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the titanium disulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

assignee_raw: Qilunhe New Energy Technology CO., LTD.
title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: A lithium metal interface with uniform nucleation and suppressed dendrite penetration along grain boundaries is described. The ion-conductive component may be beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the lithium secondary battery. An argyrodite sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The additive comprises silver in an amount of 0.2 wt% to 1 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. With the additive in an amount of 0.5 wt% and a stack pressure of 20 MPa, the Coulombic efficiency is 99%. The resulting Li3PS4 and LLZO material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. A stack pressure of 10 MPa to 40 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. The electrode mixture of the lithium secondary battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The method prevents short circuit and improves the interfacial resistance and dendrite suppression without a thick protective layer.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.5% or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 4 MPa to 100 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy
abstract: An argyrodite ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and a method for producing the same are described. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The ion-conductive component may be beta-Li3PS4. The argyrodite crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The Li3PS4 material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ceramic ion conductor to improve the cycle life of the solid-state lithium battery. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 380 degrees C to 630 degrees C, and wherein 0.25 <= x <= 1.05, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. With 3 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
