Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the lithium secondary battery. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 40 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 40 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 2 cells and a case is also provided. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Ion-conductive solid sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet comprises ion-conductive solid particles and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network that binds the particles without a solvent. The Li3PS4 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. The tensile strength is 0.6 MPa or more and the elongation at break is 5% or more. The ion-conductive solid is preferably beta-Li3PS4. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 80 degrees C to form a continuous film. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The fibrillated binder gives a flexible sheet and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.3 MPa or more, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 20 degrees C to 160 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and to a method of handling it in a dry room. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The oxygen content of 4 mol% to 16 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 20 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 1.6 mS/cm or more. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. The powder is formed into a sheet by kneading with a fibrillated PTFE binder and roll-pressing without a solvent to a thickness of 30 micrometers to 80 micrometers. The oxygen substitution amount is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an oxygen substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. A lithium battery pack comprising 2 modules of the stacked cells is also described.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The structure with the nickel-plated copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon nanotubes framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide. Polysulfide dissolution from the iron sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The cathode delivering 800 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, carbon nanotubes, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Potentiometric sulfur dioxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of sodium nitrite that converts the sulfur dioxide concentration into an ionic activity. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of sulfur dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to sulfur dioxide against interfering gases.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of sulfur dioxide.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing vinylene carbonate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, vinylene carbonate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% with the electrolyte. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The 1.2 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 35 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 15 milliohms at 100 kHz. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium bis(oxalato)borate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which sulfur is confined in the pores of porous carbon to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 200 cycles is also described. The carbon coating on the sulfur composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the sulfur cathode. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of sulfur. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing sulfur with porous carbon; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the sulfur into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 50 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The roll pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 20 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The polyaniline is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 6.3 V.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. Polysulfide dissolution from the molybdenum disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and an oxygen-rich surface region is described. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. Examples of the ion conductor include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. The method further comprises a synthesis step in which a solvate complex is precipitated and heat-treated to obtain the powder. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -30 degrees C and the exposure time is 24 hours. The oxygen substitution amount is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the cycle life are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 24 hours is 75% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The roll pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. A lithium battery pack comprising 2 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LDT.
title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: A NASICON-type or perovskite-type oxide ion-conductive solid with an oxidation limit of 4.7 V or more is described. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. Part of the titanium in the NASICON-type LATP phase is substituted by zirconium in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. A dry process in which the ion-conductive solid powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the lithium secondary battery. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 5 V. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the ionic conductivity and high-voltage stability of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.4 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Solid electrolyte sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: Disclosed is a solvent-free method of forming a solid electrolyte sheet by kneading the powder with PTFE under shear and rolling the mixture between heated rollers. With a binder content of 1 wt% and a roll temperature of 80 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 16% or less. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The Li6PS5Cl, LiNbO3, and Li2ZrO3 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. The binder is polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and the fibrils have an average diameter of 50 nm to 500 nm. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. Because the fibril network holds the particles, the sheet is self-supporting and shows improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 16% or less, and wherein the free-standing solid electrolyte sheet has a roll temperature of 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.3 MPa or more.

title: Lithium fluoride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium metal negative electrode having a protective layer with a thickness of 40 nm to 200 nm and a lithium metal battery including the same are provided. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 100 nm. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the solid-state battery. The disclosure is applicable to lithium fluoride (LiF), beta-Li3PS4, and Li3YCl6. The LiF layer of 100 nm lowers the interfacial resistance to 20 ohm cm2 or less. The material comprises lithium fluoride (LiF), beta-Li3PS4, and Li3YCl6, and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. The protective layer is useful for an anode-free cell, with improved dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 250 cycles or more, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.5% or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 80 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene based electrolyte of 50 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Lithium indium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium indium chloride formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The average thickness of the coating is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. The electrode mixture of the lithium secondary battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 85% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the lithium secondary battery. In a lithium secondary battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 15% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 70% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer comprises ceramic ion conductor particles, a styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer binder, a nonpolar solvent comprising a mixed solvent of toluene and heptane in which the binder is dissolved, and a dispersant. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The solid content is 30 wt% to 50 wt%, the viscosity is 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s, and the layer thickness is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. The binder is a rubber that keeps the layer flexible after drying and does not block the ion conduction between particles. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The material comprises Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. The peeling from the release film gives a transferable sheet and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising a mixed solvent of toluene and heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the solid content of the slurry is 30 wt% to 50 wt%, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a residual solvent content of 0.2 wt% or less. The reaction at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The suspension has a solid concentration of 2.5 wt% to 10 wt% and is reacted at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. An all-solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved moisture stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The solid electrolyte layer of scandia-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 8 mol%. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1200 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm and a relative density of 95%. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the all-solid-state lithium battery. Sintering is performed at 1200 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 1 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1000 degrees C to 1350 degrees C, and wherein 0.06 <= v <= 0.75.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. With 2 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The capacity retention of 88% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide ion-conductive solid whose decomposition current at 5 V is 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the tin substitution and the surface region. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The oxidation potential is 5 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The cubic Li6PS5X structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the high-voltage stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.4 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and production method thereof
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The material comprises lithium fluoride (LiF), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 10 cm3/g or less. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The resulting LiF material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. The ceramic ion conductor shows an ionic conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 5 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C. The ceramic ion conductor is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise lithium fluoride (LiF). A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an ion-conductive solid whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. Suitable compositions include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less. The anodic decomposition product layer after 100 cycles is 10 nm or less and the capacity retention is 80%. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the tin substitution and the surface region. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The material is useful as a catholyte in a high-voltage positive electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Halogen-rich Li6PS5X solid electrolyte having anion disorder and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A solid electrolyte comprising a crystal phase of the Li6PS5X type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. An ionic conductivity of 3.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 1.2 to 1.6. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. A mixed-halogen Li6PS5X phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 550 degrees C. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better cycle life and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 680 degrees C.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell. The carbon coating on the sulfur composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor by stirring the raw materials in ethyl propionate at 25 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the all-solid-state battery. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The ceramic ion conductor is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and a conductivity of 4.1 mS/cm. The powder is formed into a sheet by kneading with a fibrillated PTFE binder and roll-pressing without a solvent to a thickness of 30 micrometers to 80 micrometers. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.9 wt% or less, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and production method thereof
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form an ion-conductive solid of high conductivity. After heat treatment at 240 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 2.5 mS/cm. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 75:25, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved electrochemical window and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 20% to 100%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of SiS2 is 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The current collector of aluminum is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Lithium tantalate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and production method thereof
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based lithium secondary battery is described. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3) and has an average thickness of 2 nm to 10 nm and a coverage of 80% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li6PS5Cl material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 20% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Method for forming an ion-conductive solid film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: This disclosure concerns a roll-pressing method for forming an ion-conductive solid film without any solvent. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and the sheet shows a conductivity of 3 mS/cm. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the lithium secondary battery. Specific examples are argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The Li6PS5Cl, LLZO, and Li3PS4 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 30 degrees C to 90 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. The powder is synthesized by a liquid-phase route in which the raw materials are dissolved in a solvent, precipitated, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 550 degrees C. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The method shortens the process and improves the sheet formability and cycle life of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 30 degrees C to 90 degrees C, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 200 MPa. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Tantalum-doped garnet solid electrolyte sintered body with high relative density and production method thereof
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 95% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. When v is 0.25, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 0.6 mS/cm. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. Sintering is performed at 1150 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The low grain boundary resistance results in improved grain boundary resistance and sinterability compared with a garnet sintered without the aid.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 0 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein 0.06 <= v <= 0.75, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 950 degrees C to 1300 degrees C.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4, wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. The LGPS and Li3PS4 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The ceramic ion conductor can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the solid-state lithium battery. A solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. When fired at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 2.6 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. Suitable compositions include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. A solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less.
