A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a molybdenum disulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. A solid-state lithium-sulfur battery comprising the cathode mixture, a sulfide solid electrolyte layer, and a lithium indium negative electrode is also provided. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The cathode delivering 1200 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 80% at 25 degrees C. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, graphene, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite-type solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite-type family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. When fired at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the bromine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. Compared with Li6PS5Br, the iodine-substituted argyrodite-type shows a higher conductivity and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 380 degrees C to 630 degrees C.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. With 2 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by thermal evaporation and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a ceramic ion conductor layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The ceramic ion conductor powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers. The ion-conductive component may be Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A cell with the protected lithium metal negative electrode operates for 500 cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2. Because the inorganic layer blocks electron leakage, the decomposition of the ceramic ion conductor at the negative electrode is suppressed and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 10 nm to 600 nm, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.2 micrometers to 20 micrometers, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97% or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 4 stacked cells
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and production method thereof
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and iodine. An ionic conductivity of 2.6 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 1.3 to 1.7. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The ceramic ion conductor powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The disclosure is applicable to Li7P3S11. The low electronic conductivity of the Li7P3S11 material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The electrode mixture of the all-solid-state battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The material is useful as a ceramic ion conductor layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein 0.35 <= y/a <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C.

title: Potentiometric nitrogen oxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which nitrogen oxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The sensor shows a response time of 2 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 700 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The multilayer structure with the sodium beta-alumina ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The nitrogen oxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C. A lithium carbonate auxiliary electrode may be used for detecting carbon dioxide at 700 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising barium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects nitrogen oxide.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3BO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium borate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 80 mol% or more of the transition metals. A coverage of 90% and a thickness of 5 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 60%. The disclosure is applicable to Li3InCl6 and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). After ball milling, the ion-conductive solid precursor is pressed and sintered. The lithium borate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 50 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 47 microfarad rating. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Mixed potential type carbon dioxide sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 300 degrees C. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the gold sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The sensor shows a response time of 10 seconds to a step change of carbon dioxide concentration at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting carbon dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; a sensing electrode comprising gold disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Disclosed is a UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3InCl6 and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li3InCl6 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 50 mol% or more of the transition metals. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium indium chloride, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. A coverage of 95% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 30%. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The Li2ZrO3 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor for a solid-state battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y). Partial substitution of bromine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiBr impurity phase. Firing is performed at 480 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. A solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved electrochemical window. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. Compared with Li6PS5Br, the iodine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 360 degrees C to 610 degrees C.

title: Zirconium-substituted titanium-free NASICON-type oxide ion-conductive solid stable above 4.8 V and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid stable against oxidation above 4.8 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium. The positive electrode active material is a 5 V spinel, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ion-conductive solid. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The disclosure is applicable to Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The powder has a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 4.8 V. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The zirconium substitution suppresses titanium reduction and improves the high-voltage stability in contact with lithium.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.12 mS/cm or more.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. A lithium battery pack comprising 2 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The uniaxial pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. A solid electrolyte sheet of 100 micrometers is used as the separator. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium yttrium chloride coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and production method thereof
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li3YCl6 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. A solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved high-voltage stability. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 10 nm. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ceramic ion conductor to improve the cycle life of the solid-state lithium battery. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 95%. A solid-state lithium battery using the coated active material shows improved high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 25% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium difluorophosphate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The capacity retention of 88% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium difluorophosphate. The additive lithium difluorophosphate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium metal layer, an ion-conductive solid layer, and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The additive particles have a size of 200 nm and the critical current density rises from 0.6 mA/cm2 to 3 mA/cm2. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The indium additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved ionic conductivity and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 2 MPa to 50 MPa.

title: Lithium tungstate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose Li2WO4 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide solid electrolyte. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The coated particles are heat-treated at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 75% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 3 nm. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li3InCl6, lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which hydrolysis is suppressed by arsenic-free antimony substitution is provided. Heat treatment at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C gives a conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm and a retention of 70% after humid exposure. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C is 20 cm3/g. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 5 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 470 microfarad rating. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 35 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polyaniline particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 98% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 98%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Lithium niobate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium niobate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li3InCl6, and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the lithium secondary battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. The lithium niobate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with an all-solid-state battery using it. The glass phase contains P2O5 in an amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. The precipitated Li7P3S11 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm. The low electronic conductivity of the Li6PS5Cl material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl material. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The P2O5 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the moisture stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polycarbonate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The roll pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.12 or less. In an embodiment the material is argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. When fired at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 5.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.35 <= y/a <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, carbon nanotubes, and polyacrylic acid is described. A solid-state lithium-sulfur battery comprising the cathode mixture, a sulfide solid electrolyte layer, and a lithium indium negative electrode is also provided. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 4 mg/cm2. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed chlorine-iodine substitution and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by iodine. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Firing is performed at 520 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 9.6 mS/cm. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein -0.05 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less.

title: GeS2-containing vitreous sulfide solid electrolyte and heat treatment method
abstract: A glassy sulfide solid electrolyte with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LGPS and Li7P3S11 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 4 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 50%. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 260 degrees C. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid with low residual solvent for lithium battery
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid by stirring the raw materials in tetrahydrofuran at 80 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. In a lithium secondary battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the sinterability. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ion-conductive solid to improve the cycle life of the lithium secondary battery. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and a conductivity of 4.1 mS/cm. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid obtained by the method shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for carbon dioxide with improved response time
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a platinum electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the carbon dioxide concentration. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the carbon dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The carbon dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising lanthanum fluoride, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a thio-LISICON phase
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable thio-LISICON crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. A dry process in which the solid electrolyte powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the lithium secondary battery. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The glass phase contains LiI in an amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the thio-LISICON phase. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the moisture stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 100%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The additive vinylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: niobium solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The equivalent series resistance is 20 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 470 microfarad rating. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 20 milliohms or less.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The capacitor withstands 150 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region and lithium battery
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and an arsenic-free antimony-rich surface region is described. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11. A solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. An H2S generation of 20 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 70% or more are obtained. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the ionic conductivity and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 20 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant gallium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1200 degrees C shows a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm and a relative density of 96%. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 4 micrometers to 30 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The Li2ZrO3 and LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. A lithium excess of 5 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the solid-state lithium battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the sinterability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 93% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 4 micrometers to 30 micrometers.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 10 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium difluorophosphate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The capacitor rated at 35 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 10 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 3 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate is also described. With 3 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The capacity retention of 90% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode.
