A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: nickel sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The cathode delivering 1200 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising graphene; nickel sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid in which hydrolysis is suppressed by tin substitution is provided. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11 and Li3PS4 material. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. The tin content of 1 mol% to 4 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 20 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 3.1 mS/cm or more. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11 and beta-Li3PS4. The ion-conductive solid can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the lithium secondary battery. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the sinterability are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The roll pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form an ion-conductive solid of high conductivity. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 240 degrees C. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The disclosure is applicable to Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. The content of GeS2 is 8 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 240 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.8 mS/cm or more. The ion-conductive solid can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the solid-state lithium battery. A solid-state lithium battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 20% to 100%.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: This disclosure concerns an additive that alloys with lithium during plating and prevents short circuit through the solid electrolyte. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The additive layer has a thickness of 0.5 micrometers to 5 micrometers and is lithiophilic. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The lithium fluoride additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. A Coulombic efficiency of 98.8% or more and a critical current density of 4 mA/cm2 are obtained at 25 degrees C. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The method prevents short circuit and improves the ionic conductivity and interfacial resistance without a thick protective layer.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the content of the lithium fluoride additive is 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 98.8% or more.

title: Hafnium-substituted lithium yttrium chloride solid electrolyte with trigonal structure and method for producing the same
abstract: A rare earth metal halide solid electrolyte with cation disorder and a hexachloride framework is described. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. The oxidation stability limit is 4.1 V or more and the conductivity is 0.56 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The trigonal phase is obtained by heat treatment at 250 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li3InCl6 and Li3YCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved high-voltage stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein 0.3 <= z <= 0.55.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium bis(oxalato)borate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The uniaxial pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The cold isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Self-supporting ion-conductive solid sheet having low porosity and method for calendering the same
abstract: Disclosed is a solvent-free method of forming an ion-conductive solid sheet by kneading the powder with PTFE under shear and rolling the mixture between heated rollers. In an embodiment the material is argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The Li6PS5Cl material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The tensile strength is 1.8 MPa or more and the elongation at break is 5% or more. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. Because the fibril network holds the particles, the sheet is self-supporting and shows improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more.

title: Mixed-halide solid electrolyte of erbium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed chloride anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.3 micrometers to 3 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the solid electrolyte layer onto an electrode of the solid-state battery without a drying step. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The oxidation stability limit is 4.3 V or more and the conductivity is 0.56 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. In the monoclinic structure, erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The halide solid electrolyte is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the moisture stability and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.5, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 130 degrees C to 370 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: A rare earth metal halide ion-conductive solid with cation disorder and a hexachloride framework is described. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.2 to 0.45. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the ion-conductive solid layer onto an electrode of the all-solid-state battery without a drying step. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The hafnium substitution in an amount z of 0.2 to 0.45 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The ion-conductive solid is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the high-voltage stability. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.7, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.8 V or more.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The active material lithium sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The confinement of lithium sulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing lithium sulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the lithium sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Tin-substituted sulfide ion-conductive solid with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The ion-conductive solid can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the solid-state lithium battery. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. A solid-state lithium battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The ion-conductive solid retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 1 hours is 65% or more.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Mixed potential type sulfur dioxide sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The protective layer improves the durability of the gadolinium-doped ceria sensor in an exhaust gas. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of sulfur dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sulfur dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium borate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and production method thereof
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li3BO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and nickel content of 75 mol% or more. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. A solid-state battery using the coated active material shows improved cycle life and electrochemical window and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 500 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 100 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by uniaxial pressing. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide ceramic ion conductor whose decomposition current at 5 V is 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. Examples of the ion conductor include Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The ceramic ion conductor powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers. The substitution amount is 5 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.5 V or more and a conductivity of 0.49 mS/cm or more. The oxide particles have a core of the titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in tin. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. The tin substitution suppresses titanium reduction and improves the high-voltage stability and sinterability in contact with lithium.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 83% or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The cold isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiTaO3 shell with high coverage and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose LiTaO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide ceramic ion conductor. The ceramic ion conductor is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The average thickness of the coating is 6 nm to 30 nm, the coverage is 85% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved high-voltage stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 70% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.5 nm to 75 nm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 15 milliohms at 100 kHz. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. The polyaniline is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a aluminum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 6.3 V.

title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the suppression of lithium filament growth in a solid-state cell by an additive that promotes uniform plating and stripping. The additive content is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, the stack pressure is 10 MPa to 40 MPa, and the critical current density is 1.5 mA/cm2. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The additive layer has a thickness of 0.5 micrometers to 5 micrometers and is lithiophilic. The Li3YCl6 and LiF material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. Because nucleation is uniform, the local current density is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.8% or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more during cycling is described. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte resistant to hydrolysis under humid air
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and an arsenic-free antimony-rich surface region is described. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. Specific examples are argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. The powder used for the sheet is prepared by a wet-chemical synthesis with filtration and drying, and the moisture exposure is controlled by a dew point of -40 degrees C. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. The arsenic-free antimony content of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 10 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 3.1 mS/cm or more. A lithium secondary battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 1 hours is 80% or more.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The capacitor withstands 150 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The lithium salt is lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a aluminum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. A capacitance of 47 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 47 microfarad rating. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises nickel sulfide impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. The nickel sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The positive electrode mixture may contain a solid electrolyte such as Li3PS4 as an ion-conducting additive. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon coating on the nickel sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. With 2 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The uniaxial pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Amperometric sulfur dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The sensor detects sulfur dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 10 seconds. The sensor operating at 700 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for sulfur dioxide. The limiting current is proportional to the sulfur dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting sulfur dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising gold disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 30 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. A solid electrolyte sheet of 30 micrometers is used as the separator. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The uniaxial pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Dendrite-suppressing lithium fluoride additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is a dendrite-suppressing structure in which a lithium fluoride-containing additive at the lithium interface raises the critical current density. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. Suitable compositions include lithium fluoride (LiF). The critical current density at 25 degrees C is 2 mA/cm2 and the cell survives 500 cycles of plating and stripping without short circuit. An all-solid-state battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ion-conductive solid shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The additive layer has a thickness of 0.5 micrometers to 5 micrometers and is lithiophilic. The alloy formation lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the content of the lithium fluoride additive is 0.1 wt% to 5 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte for an all-solid-state battery has a Li6PS5X crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 6 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The resulting Li3PS4, LGPS, and Li7P3S11 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3 mS/cm or more.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ceramic ion conductor using acetonitrile
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a residual solvent content of 0.2 wt% or less. The reaction at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The suspension has a solid concentration of 2.5 wt% to 10 wt% and is reacted at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl and LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Specific examples are argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 40 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 1 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.6 wt% or less.

title: Lithium indium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li3InCl6 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. A coverage of 80% and a thickness of 15 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 40%. The LiNbO3 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The coated particles are heat-treated at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. In an embodiment the material is lithium niobate (LiNbO3). A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. In a solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The electrode mixture of the solid-state battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. A solid-state battery using the coated active material shows improved cycle life and electrochemical window and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.5 nm to 75 nm.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method for sintering a tantalum-doped Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet to a relative density of 91% or more while suppressing lithium volatilization. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. An argyrodite sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. When v is 0.2, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 0.4 mS/cm. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the grain boundary resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 5 mol% to 25 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 950 degrees C to 1300 degrees C.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 10 mol%. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1020 degrees C to 1170 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1100 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm and a relative density of 95%. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the high-voltage stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 5 mol% to 25 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 87% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more.

title: molybdenum disulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. A lithium-sulfur battery with the molybdenum disulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode with a loading of 4 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing molybdenum disulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the molybdenum disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The current collector of aluminum is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cold isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The uniaxial pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The active material lithium sulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The positive electrode mixture may contain a solid electrolyte such as Li3PS4 as an ion-conducting additive. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Crystallized sulfide crystallized glass ion conductor containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a ceramic ion conductor of high conductivity. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. A solid-state lithium battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved ionic conductivity and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a self-supporting ceramic ion conductor film produced by powder-to-film rolling and calendering. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The LLZO and Li3PS4 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles.
