abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The equivalent series resistance is 20 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Tantalum-doped garnet solid electrolyte sintered body with high relative density and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant tantalum stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. Sintering at 1150 degrees C with a lithium excess of 10 mol% gives a relative density of 95% and a conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm. A superionic argyrodite phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. After ball milling, the solid electrolyte precursor is pressed and sintered. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. A solid-state battery comprising the LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Sintering is performed at 1150 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 92% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Mixed potential type hydrogen sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising platinum, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The multilayer structure with the yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The limiting current is proportional to the hydrogen concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Bromine-substituted Li6PS5X ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ceramic ion conductor having a cubic Li6PS5X structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The Li7P3S11 and Li3PS4 material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. A precursor of the Li7P3S11 and Li3PS4 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The ceramic ion conductor exhibits an ionic conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11 and beta-Li3PS4. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The material is useful as a ceramic ion conductor layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 1.2 <= a <= 2, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium metal halide ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6 and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed chloride anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. The ceramic ion conductor is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The composition forms a shell on the cathode particles that suppresses the space-charge layer, so that the halide serves as the coating layer. The cubic argyrodite structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, InCl3, and TiCl4 followed by heat treatment at 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C. After dehydration under vacuum at 250 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm. Specific examples are Li3InCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved moisture stability and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which indium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 200 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Ti(z)Br6 and production method thereof
abstract: Described is a lithium scandium bromide solid electrolyte prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The material comprises lithium fluoride (LiF) and Li3YCl6, and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.9 micrometers to 9 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The ion-conductive component may be lithium fluoride (LiF) and Li3YCl6. After dehydration under vacuum at 200 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The titanium substitution lowers the raw material cost of the rare earth halide and improves the ionic conductivity and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.8 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 80 degrees C to 320 degrees C.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.1, and the room-temperature conductivity is 9.6 mS/cm. The mixed halogen substitution improves the electrochemical window of the solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1.1 <= a <= 1.5, and wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. A solid electrolyte sheet of 100 micrometers is used as the separator. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and lithium battery
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid for an all-solid-state battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The ion-conductive solid is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. When fired at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. The ion-conductive solid is preferably beta-Li3PS4 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less, and wherein 0.15 <= x <= 0.95, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3 mS/cm or more.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ion-conductive solid that does not require long mechanical milling. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the solid-state battery. Heat treatment at 550 degrees C after drying at 200 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1 mS/cm or more. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. A solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid obtained by the method shows improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li3YCl6 shell with high coverage and production method thereof
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based solid-state battery is described. The coating layer has an average thickness of 3 nm and a coverage of 95%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 40% relative to uncoated particles. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 80 mol% or more of the transition metals. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The Li2ZrO3 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for oxygen with improved response time
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 400 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The limiting current is proportional to the oxygen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Wet coating method for forming an ion-conductive solid layer on a release film and production method thereof
abstract: This disclosure concerns a slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer that has a solid content of 60 wt% to 80 wt% and a viscosity of 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s. The slurry has a solid content of 60 wt% to 80 wt% and a viscosity of 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, which is suitable for doctor blade casting. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. Specific examples are argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The binder content is 3 wt%, the drying temperature is 100 degrees C, and the decrease in conductivity after slurry processing is 20% or less. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. The wet process is useful for forming a layer on a large area, with improved cycle life and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the solid content of the slurry is 45 wt% to 90 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 60 degrees C to 160 degrees C.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Argyrodite-type sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-iodine substitution and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and to a lithium secondary battery comprising the same. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.03, and the room-temperature conductivity is 3.5 mS/cm. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11. The material is useful as a solid electrolyte layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein -0.05 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 100 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Zirconium-substituted lithium erbium chloride solid electrolyte with orthorhombic structure and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Described is a lithium erbium chloride solid electrolyte prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. An argyrodite-type phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. In the orthorhombic structure, erbium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved ionic conductivity and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C.

title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a lithium fluoride-containing additive layer
abstract: A lithium metal interface with uniform nucleation and suppressed dendrite penetration along grain boundaries is described. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li2ZrO3, LLTO, and LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A stack pressure of 10 MPa to 40 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. The additive content is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, the stack pressure is 10 MPa to 40 MPa, and the critical current density is 3 mA/cm2. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The suppression of void formation improves the sinterability and high-voltage stability during fast charging.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 10 MPa to 40 MPa, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 500 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Disclosed is a UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 70:30 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is beta-Li3PS4, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11 and LGPS material. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 50%. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the moisture stability of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a aluminum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 10 V.

title: Solid electrolyte slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer comprises solid electrolyte particles, a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder, a nonpolar solvent comprising a mixed solvent of toluene and heptane in which the binder is dissolved, and a dispersant. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The powder is synthesized by a liquid-phase route in which the raw materials are dissolved in a solvent, precipitated, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 550 degrees C. In a solid-state lithium battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the interfacial resistance. The wet film is dried at 60 degrees C and the dried layer has a thickness of 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers. The solid content is 30 wt% to 50 wt%, the viscosity is 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s, and the layer thickness is 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers. The nonpolar solvent does not degrade the solid electrolyte, and the layer shows improved interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising a mixed solvent of toluene and heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 30 wt% to 50 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and a film-forming additive
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 300 degrees C. The sensor detects carbon dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 5 seconds. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The sensor operating at 300 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for carbon dioxide.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 98%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 500 to 650 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The scandia-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Titanium-substituted lithium indium bromide ion-conductive solid with monoclinic structure for lithium battery
abstract: Described is a lithium indium bromide ion-conductive solid prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. The titanium substitution in an amount z of 0.1 to 0.35 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium fluoride (LiF). A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. Heat treatment at 350 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a monoclinic phase with a conductivity of 0.56 mS/cm or more. The halide ion-conductive solid is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which indium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.6.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li2ZrO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 85%. The coating layer has an average thickness of 10 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 60% relative to uncoated particles. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 15 mol%. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the all-solid-state battery. The ion-conductive component may be lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1150 degrees C, and the resulting density is 96%. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The dopant tantalum occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.1 to 0.45, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 88% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.06 <= v <= 0.75.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 8 milliohms or less.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, ketjen black, and carboxymethyl cellulose is described. Polysulfide dissolution from the nickel sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 800 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the nickel sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The nickel sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyethylene oxide matrix, lithium hexafluorophosphate as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3YCl6 and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium yttrium chloride and to a method for producing the same. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 40% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. An argyrodite-type sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium yttrium chloride, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The high coverage of the coating results in improved electrochemical window at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 70% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polycarbonate matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyethylene oxide; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 15 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 600 to 750 degrees C is described. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an ion-conductive solid whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. The anodic decomposition product layer after 100 cycles is 10 nm or less and the capacity retention is 80%. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mS/cm or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 2 cells and a case is also provided. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The cold isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium bis(oxalato)borate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polycarbonate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polycarbonate based electrolyte of 100 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polycarbonate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The sulfur cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The confinement of sulfur in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. The carbon coating on the sulfur composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing sulfur with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the sulfur into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. A lithium-sulfur battery with the molybdenum disulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the ketjen black suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. Polysulfide dissolution from the molybdenum disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 35 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
