The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The roll pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Amperometric hydrogen sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of lithium carbonate that converts the hydrogen concentration into an ionic activity. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the gold sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The solid electrolyte of sodium beta-alumina conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The hydrogen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 500 degrees C. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of hydrogen concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising sodium beta-alumina, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Lithium fluoride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a protective layer comprising a LiF inorganic layer and a fluorinated polymer for a lithium metal negative electrode. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A lithium secondary battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ion-conductive solid shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. After 300 cycles at 0.5 mA/cm2 the cell retains a Coulombic efficiency of 98.5% and no dendrite penetration is observed. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. The polymer layer keeps the contact during volume change and improves the dendrite suppression and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 75 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.1 micrometers to 10 micrometers.

title: Mixed-halide solid electrolyte of indium and zirconium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a halide solid electrolyte in which zirconium is substituted for part of the indium in a lithium indium chloride framework. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li3InCl6. When z is 0.1, the conductivity is 3 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.5 V. In the monoclinic structure, indium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The material comprises Li3InCl6, and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the all-solid-state battery. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved electrochemical window. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which indium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: Described is a method of operating a solid-state lithium cell under a stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa with a lithium fluoride additive. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li3YCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The critical current density is 2.1 mA/cm2 or more and the number of cycles without short circuit is 150 cycles or more. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.8% or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 60 cycles or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive in an amount of 2 wt%. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. With 2 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The capacity retention of 90% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 500 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The warm isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. A 10 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The uniaxial pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as a 5 V spinel. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The oxidation potential is 5 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 5 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLTO and LATP material. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the zirconium substitution and the surface region. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The oxide particles have a core of the NASICON-type LATP phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in zirconium. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.7 V or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the ion-conductive solid is improved. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The oxygen substitution amount is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -30 degrees C and the exposure time is 24 hours. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved moisture stability and sinterability and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 25 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 24 hours is 45% or more.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide solid electrolyte whose decomposition current at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The ion-conductive component may be Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.2 V or more and a conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm or more. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The solid electrolyte is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 25 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 73% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 3.9 V or more.

title: Mixed-halide solid electrolyte of yttrium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: A halide ion conductor having the composition Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6, wherein z is 0.1 to 0.35, and a method for producing the same are provided. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The orthorhombic phase is obtained by heat treatment at 250 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. The Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and LiF material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. After dehydration under vacuum at 250 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, YCl3, and HfCl4 followed by heat treatment at 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved electrochemical window and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. With 1 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance
abstract: A garnet solid electrolyte sintered body having an average grain size of 2 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. When v is 0.4, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm. Suitable compositions include Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The LLTO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 92% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1 <= a <= 1.8, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Lithium metal halide ion-conductive solid represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Br6 and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a trigonal halide ion-conductive solid in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites of a close-packed chloride lattice. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. In the trigonal structure, yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed bromide sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 3 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.2 to 0.45. An argyrodite sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. The disclosure is applicable to Li3YCl6. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. Because the chloride framework is oxidation-resistant, the ionic conductivity at 4.3 V is improved.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 5 mol%. A lithium excess of 5 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. In an embodiment the material is Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The total ionic conductivity is 0.28 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.01 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 84% or more.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid that remains stable up to 4.5 V and a lithium battery with a high-voltage cathode are provided. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. The ion-conductive component may be Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The oxide particles have a core of the perovskite-type LLTO phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in germanium. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. A capacity retention of 90% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. In a solid-state lithium battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the sinterability. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. The widened electrochemical window improves the sinterability of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 85% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polypyrrole doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The polypyrrole is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Dendrite-suppressing lithium fluoride additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell and method for preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a dendrite-suppressing structure in which a lithium fluoride-containing additive at the lithium interface raises the critical current density. The critical current density at 25 degrees C is 2 mA/cm2 and the cell survives 1000 cycles of plating and stripping without short circuit. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. During stripping, the alloy phase of the additive keeps the contact and suppresses void growth. The LiF, Li3PS4, and Li3YCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the content of the lithium fluoride additive is 0.5 wt% to 25 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.5% or more.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a molybdenum disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into carbon nanotubes at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. A lithium-sulfur battery with the molybdenum disulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The molybdenum disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with carbon nanotubes by ball milling. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising molybdenum disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 200 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide ceramic ion conductor with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y) and to a solid-state battery comprising the same. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.2 <= y/a <= 0.5, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobium tantalum oxide, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 80% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3InCl6 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 50% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 40 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a ceramic ion conductor comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 50%. Crystallization is performed at 280 degrees C to 360 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 8 hours, which precipitates a beta-Li3PS4 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 320 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 4 mS/cm. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is beta-Li3PS4, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the all-solid-state battery. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the moisture stability of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 10% to 100%, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Potentiometric hydrogen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to hydrogen against interfering gases. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor shows a response time of 2 seconds to a step change of hydrogen concentration at 700 degrees C. The sensor operating at 700 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for hydrogen.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects hydrogen.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The additive 1,3-propane sultone is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% with the electrolyte. The capacity retention of 90% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without 1,3-propane sultone. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Titanium-substituted lithium yttrium bromide ion-conductive solid with orthorhombic structure and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed bromide anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. A solid-state lithium battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. An argyrodite-type phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. A halide coating is compatible with the ion-conductive solid because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. In an embodiment the material is Li3YCl6 and Li3InCl6. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, YBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C. The halide ion-conductive solid is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.47 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C.

title: Slurry composition for a ceramic ion conductor layer using a nonpolar solvent and styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer
abstract: A wet film of a ceramic ion conductor cast on a PET release film and dried in an oven is described. The coating speed is 5 m/min and the layer dried at 100 degrees C to 140 degrees C has a thickness of 30 micrometers. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The slurry has a solid content of 30 wt% to 50 wt% and a viscosity of 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, which is suitable for doctor blade casting. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl and LATP material. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the ceramic ion conductor layer onto an electrode of the lithium secondary battery without a drying step. The slurry allows roll-to-roll production of the layer and improves the ionic conductivity of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing GeS2. The content of GeS2 is 3 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 240 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.8 mS/cm or more. Crystallization is performed at 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which precipitates a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The ion-conductive solid shows improved cycle life and electrochemical window compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 24 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 0.6 mol% to 12 mol%.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 40 cm3/g or less. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li6PS5Cl and Li3PS4 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The oxygen content of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 40 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 3.1 mS/cm or more. The ion-conductive component may be Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an oxygen substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Silicon-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the ceramic ion conductor layer onto an electrode of the lithium secondary battery without a drying step. The silicon substitution amount is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the lithium secondary battery. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The ceramic ion conductor is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. After exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity retention is 85%. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the moisture stability are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a silicon substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 4 stacked cells
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Mixed potential type carbon dioxide sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a lanthanum strontium manganite electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the carbon dioxide concentration. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate makes the sensor selective to carbon dioxide against interfering gases. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of carbon dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The ceramic is gadolinium-doped ceria and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 400 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting carbon dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The current collector of nickel-plated copper is used in a lithium battery with a 30 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which sulfur is confined in the pores of graphene to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the sulfur cathode. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 3 mg/cm2. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of sulfur.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing sulfur with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the sulfur into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. A solid electrolyte sheet of 50 micrometers is used as the separator. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more during cycling is described. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The uniaxial pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. The polyaniline is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The capacitor has a capacitance of 220 microfarads, a rated voltage of 16 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 20 milliohms at 100 kHz. The niobium capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li7P3S11 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 60%. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 260 degrees C. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 60%. Crystallization is performed at 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which precipitates a Li7P3S11 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. A solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved cycle life and rate performance.
first_claim: 1.
