A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm. The oxygen substitution amount is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A solid-state battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ceramic ion conductor shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the ionic conductivity are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 24 hours is 80% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: Described is an oxide ceramic ion conductor whose decomposition current at 5 V is 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. An all-solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 87% or more. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the tin substitution and the surface region. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. Specific examples are lithium fluoride (LiF) and beta-Li3PS4. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 77% or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.6 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The sensor detects carbon dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to carbon dioxide against interfering gases. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 300 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The limiting current is proportional to the carbon dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting carbon dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate; a sensing electrode comprising gold disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for preparing the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 94% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. The resulting Li2ZrO3, LATP, and LLZO material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. The sintered body has a relative density of 94%, an average grain size of 10 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3, LATP, and LLZO material. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the sinterability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.35 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 4 micrometers to 30 micrometers.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte and to a lithium battery including the same. The grain size is 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and the relative density is 91% or more after sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. A sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The solid electrolyte powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the high-voltage stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 0.2 micrometers to 12 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 86% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 3 mol% to 23 mol%.

title: Dendrite-suppressing lithium fluoride additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell for lithium battery
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor comprises a lithium metal layer, a ceramic ion conductor layer, and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. A Coulombic efficiency of 98.8% or more and a critical current density of 3 mA/cm2 are obtained at 25 degrees C. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The additive comprises lithium fluoride in an amount of 2 wt% to 10 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved ionic conductivity and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the content of the lithium fluoride additive is 0.5 wt% to 25 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 1 MPa to 25 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.8% or more.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid electrolyte whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. A dry process is preferred for forming the solid electrolyte sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The solid electrolyte is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. In a lithium secondary battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. The solid electrolyte can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the lithium secondary battery. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the zirconium substitution and the surface region. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. The substitution amount is 5 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.2 V or more and a conductivity of 0.35 mS/cm or more. The oxide solid electrolyte enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 87% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a molybdenum disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into porous carbon at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The positive electrode mixture comprises the sulfide active material, a sulfide solid electrolyte of Li6PS5Cl in an amount of 20 wt% to 40 wt%, and carbon, for use in an all-solid-state lithium-sulfur battery. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The cathode delivering 800 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of molybdenum disulfide. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing molybdenum disulfide with porous carbon; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the molybdenum disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for sulfur dioxide with improved response time
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a lanthanum strontium manganite electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the sulfur dioxide concentration. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum fluoride conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising lanthanum fluoride, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Lithium zirconate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium zirconate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The material comprises lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li3InCl6, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The average thickness of the coating is 2 nm to 10 nm, the coverage is 75% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LiNbO3 and Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the electrochemical window is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiNbO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium niobate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. The coating layer has an average thickness of 3 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 40% relative to uncoated particles. The resulting Li3InCl6 and LiNbO3 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. Examples of the ion conductor include Li3InCl6 and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 15% or more.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The 100 microfarad capacitor smooths the output of a lithium battery converter. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The solid electrolyte can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state lithium battery. The LLZO, Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The solid electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 20 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the ionic conductivity and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 100 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours is 60% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The capacity retention of 88% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 3 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 5 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The active material is coated with a thin lithium phosphosulfide ion conductor layer so that the cathode can be used in a solid-state cell. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: lithium sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, porous carbon, and polyacrylic acid is described. Polysulfide dissolution from the lithium sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. A lithium-sulfur battery with the lithium sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite-type family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li7P3S11 and LGPS material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. A mixed-halogen argyrodite-type phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 520 degrees C. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The Li7P3S11 and LGPS material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. When fired at 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 3.8 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite-type shows a higher conductivity and better cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 8 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing silica nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a high-voltage stable oxide ion conductor based on Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO and a method for forming its oxidation-resistant surface. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li2ZrO3 and LLTO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 75% or more. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The widened electrochemical window improves the high-voltage stability and sinterability of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 100 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 3.9 V or more.

title: Method for forming an ion-conductive solid film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: An ion-conductive solid sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and a solid-state lithium battery including the sheet are described. No solvent is used in the process, so the ion-conductive solid does not react with a polar solvent and retains its conductivity. Suitable compositions include Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), and Li3InCl6. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The electrode mixture of the solid-state lithium battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The resulting Li3YCl6, LiF, and Li3InCl6 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. The ion-conductive solid is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The Li3YCl6, LiF, and Li3InCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. The binder content is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, which gives a tensile strength of 2 MPa and a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. The low porosity results in a low areal resistance and improved ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the thickness of the sheet is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 30% or less.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The cold isostatic pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 100 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a magnesium-containing additive layer
abstract: Described is a method of operating a solid-state lithium cell under a stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa with a magnesium additive. The additive layer has a thickness of 0.5 micrometers to 5 micrometers and is lithiophilic. The Li3PS4 and LLZO material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The cell shows no short circuit for 500 cycles at 1 mA/cm2 and 1 mAh/cm2 under a stack pressure of 5 MPa. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising magnesium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 250 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the content of the magnesium additive is 0.2 wt% to 1 wt%.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The capacitor has a capacitance of 100 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 15 milliohms at 100 kHz. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The capacitor rated at 25 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 2 wt%. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The capacity retention of 85% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without 1,3-propane sultone. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a lanthanum fluoride solid electrolyte for detecting oxygen
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen comprises a lanthanum fluoride ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising platinum, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The sensor operating at 300 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for oxygen. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum fluoride conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The limiting current is proportional to the oxygen concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of oxygen.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. With 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: GeS2-containing vitreous sulfide ion-conductive solid and heat treatment method
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form an ion-conductive solid of high conductivity. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The Li3PS4 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 2.5 mS/cm. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the electrochemical window is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 40 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 210 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 10% to 100%.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO, Li7P3S11, and Li3PS4 material. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite-type having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. After ball milling, the solid electrolyte precursor is pressed and sintered. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. The method does not require long mechanical milling and gives a solid electrolyte with improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1.5 wt% or less.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD
title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. Heat treatment at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm and a retention of 85% after humid exposure. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and LLZO material. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ceramic ion conductor powder. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. A solid-state lithium battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a silicon substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Argyrodite sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide solid electrolyte having a cubic argyrodite structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm. A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 480 degrees C. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the electrochemical window of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1.1 <= a <= 1.9, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 500 MPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A lithium battery pack comprising 2 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. A solid electrolyte sheet of 100 micrometers is used as the separator. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyacrylonitrile matrix, lithium hexafluorophosphate as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Tin-substituted sulfide ion-conductive solid with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid tin binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The powder is amorphized by mechanical milling in a dry room with a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower and then heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4. A precursor of the Li3PS4 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The Li3PS4 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. An H2S generation of 20 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 75% or more are obtained. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the moisture stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 20 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 15 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: A negative electrode structure with a critical current density of 1.4 mA/cm2 or more and a method for suppressing void formation during stripping are provided. During stripping, the alloy phase of the additive keeps the contact and suppresses void growth. A Coulombic efficiency of 98.8% or more and a critical current density of 2 mA/cm2 are obtained at 25 degrees C. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. In a solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The ion-conductive component may be lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3YCl6, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The negative electrode structure gives a higher critical current density and improved ionic conductivity and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 40 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 0.4 MPa to 10 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.8% or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 4 stacked cells. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. The material comprises Li7P3S11 and beta-Li3PS4, wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11 and beta-Li3PS4. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ion-conductive solid layer. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.05 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and lithium battery
