The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6 and method for preparing the same
abstract: A rare earth metal halide solid electrolyte with cation disorder and a hexachloride framework is described. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and Li7P3S11. The cubic argyrodite structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl, LGPS, and Li7P3S11 material. Heat treatment at 250 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a monoclinic phase with a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm or more. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved cycle life and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a zinc-containing additive layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns an additive that alloys with lithium during plating and prevents short circuit through the solid electrolyte. A Coulombic efficiency of 99% or more and a critical current density of 1 mA/cm2 are obtained at 25 degrees C. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the LLZO, Li3YCl6, and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The electrode mixture of the all-solid-state lithium battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. A stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. An all-solid-state lithium battery using a lithium metal anode together with the solid electrolyte shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The suppression of void formation improves the ionic conductivity and interfacial resistance during fast charging.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the content of the zinc additive is 0.1 wt% to 5 wt%, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a solid electrolyte layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The LLZO and Li3PS4 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and beta-Li3PS4, and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and beta-Li3PS4. The bilayer with a total thickness of 1 micrometer gives 500 cycles of stable plating and stripping. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 300 nm. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. A lithium metal battery using the protective layer shows improved dendrite suppression and Coulombic efficiency.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 250 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.8% or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method for forming an ion-conductive solid film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: An ion-conductive solid sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and an all-solid-state battery including the sheet are described. The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The roll temperature is 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C and the sheet has a thickness of 20 micrometers after calendering. An all-solid-state battery using the sheet shows improved interfacial resistance and a thinner electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 32% or less, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 20 degrees C to 200 degrees C.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by solution casting and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Described is an inorganic-polymer bilayer that protects the lithium metal negative electrode against the solid electrolyte. The argyrodite phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. The LLZO and Li3PS4 material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and beta-Li3PS4. A cell with the protected lithium metal negative electrode operates for 200 cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The bilayer structure improves the cycle life and dendrite suppression compared with a single inorganic layer.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The samarium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Tin-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. The tin substitution amount is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li7P3S11. A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the lithium secondary battery. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -30 degrees C and the exposure time is 6 hours. The substitution amount is 5 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm or more. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The low electronic conductivity of the Li3PS4, LLZO, and Li7P3S11 material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the grain boundary resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours is 65% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less.

title: Potentiometric hydrogen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of lithium carbonate that converts the hydrogen concentration into an ionic activity. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The ceramic is gadolinium-doped ceria and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 400 degrees C. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of hydrogen concentration at 400 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of hydrogen.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Potentiometric oxygen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of oxygen concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

assignee_raw: University Of Selexen INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC Cooperation Foundation
assignee_db_group: UNIVERSITY OF SELEXEN INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a lithium fluoride-containing additive layer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the suppression of lithium filament growth in a solid-state cell by an additive that promotes uniform plating and stripping. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LiF and Li3PS4 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the all-solid-state battery. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium fluoride (LiF) and beta-Li3PS4. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. Lithium penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed because the nucleation is uniform and the current density is below the critical value. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The critical current density is 1 mA/cm2 or more and the number of cycles without short circuit is 500 cycles or more. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the content of the lithium fluoride additive is 0.1 wt% to 5 wt%, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 200 cycles or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li3InCl6 shell with high coverage and production method thereof
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium indium chloride formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6) and has an average thickness of 2 nm to 10 nm and a coverage of 75% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. Nickel accounts for 85 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 300 degrees C. The ion-conductive component may be lithium niobate (LiNbO3), argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A halide coating is compatible with the ion-conductive solid because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The LiNbO3, Li6PS5Cl, and Li2ZrO3 material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved interfacial resistance and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The titanium disulfide is melt-diffused into carbon nanotubes at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The active material titanium disulfide is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The carbon nanotubes framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising titanium disulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the titanium disulfide is 2 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3PS4 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably beta-Li3PS4. The reaction at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. After drying, the residual solvent content is 1 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved sinterability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1 mS/cm or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 500 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The cold isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte for detecting carbon dioxide
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a lanthanum strontium manganite electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the carbon dioxide concentration. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The carbon dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C. The protective layer improves the durability of the gadolinium-doped ceria sensor in an exhaust gas. The ceramic is gadolinium-doped ceria and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising barium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects carbon dioxide.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 500 MPa. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polycarbonate and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by atomic layer deposition and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a ceramic ion conductor layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. The low electronic conductivity of the LLZO, Li3PS4, and LiF material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The Al2O3 layer of 200 nm lowers the interfacial resistance to 20 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium metal battery using the protective layer shows improved ionic conductivity and Coulombic efficiency.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising aluminum oxide deposited by atomic layer deposition (Al2O3) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 150 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.8% or more.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2ZrO3 shell with high coverage and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li2ZrO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The coated particles are heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A coverage of 85% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 30%. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the ion-conductive solid layer onto an electrode of the all-solid-state battery without a drying step. An all-solid-state battery using the coated active material shows improved interfacial resistance and high-voltage stability and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 5% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor obtained by controlled crystallization of an amorphous Li2S-P2S5-Li2O glass. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 40% to 75% by X-ray diffraction. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The electrode mixture of the solid-state battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The disclosure is applicable to Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C, and wherein the content of Li2O is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polycarbonate matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a plasticizer. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polycarbonate and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Potentiometric carbon dioxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to carbon dioxide against interfering gases. The carbon dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 500 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of carbon dioxide concentration at 500 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects carbon dioxide.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A solid electrolyte comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. Suitable compositions include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. A mixed-halogen argyrodite-type phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 450 degrees C. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.1, and the room-temperature conductivity is 9.6 mS/cm. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The solid electrolyte provides improved cycle life and ionic conductivity compared with a single-halogen argyrodite-type of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 7.2 mS/cm or more.

title: SiS2-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing SiS2. A solid-state battery comprising the LiF, Li3YCl6, and Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. In an embodiment the material is lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3YCl6, and Li3InCl6. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. The precipitated Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 420 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without vinylene carbonate. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Method for forming an ion-conductive solid film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: This disclosure concerns a roll-pressing method for forming an ion-conductive solid film without any solvent. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The binder is polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) in an amount of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%, and the fibrils have an average diameter of 50 nm to 500 nm. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The binder content is 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%, which gives a tensile strength of 2 MPa and a conductivity of 3 mS/cm. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The sheet can be laminated onto an electrode without a drying step and improves the cycle life and electrochemical window of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 30% or less.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride. Polysulfide dissolution from the sulfur cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid silicon binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. The silicon substitution amount is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The low electronic conductivity of the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LLZO material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The powder is hygroscopic to an extent of 1 wt% or less of water uptake at 10% relative humidity. A halide coating is compatible with the solid electrolyte because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. An H2S generation of 40 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 80% or more are obtained. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours is 80% or more.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based all-solid-state battery is described. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The solid electrolyte can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4, LLZO, and LiF material. The coated particles are heat-treated at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 90% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and nickel content of 75 mol% or more. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 25% or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant tantalum stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The solid electrolyte is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1150 degrees C, and the resulting density is 94%. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. A solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. A superionic argyrodite phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 0.2 micrometers to 12 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 86% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.24 mS/cm or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ion-conductive solid that does not require long mechanical milling. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm or more. The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The cubic argyrodite structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The solvent is ethyl acetate, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. A solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for a solid-state battery. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.6 wt% or less, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C.

assignee_raw: Hwaseol Natl Research Inst of Energy Materials
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATL RESEARCH INST OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the suppression of lithium filament growth in a solid-state cell by an additive that promotes uniform plating and stripping. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. The plating overpotential is 30 mV or less and the Coulombic efficiency is 99.5% after 100 cycles. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The additive comprises indium in an amount of 2 wt% to 10 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise beta-Li3PS4. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. Because nucleation is uniform, the local current density is reduced and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 4 MPa to 100 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium indium chloride coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium indium chloride formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. A halide conductor of the hexachloride type with cation disorder forms part of the composition, so that the material is both a coating and a halide conductor. The ceramic ion conductor is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. A coverage of 90% and a thickness of 15 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 40%. The resulting Li6PS5Cl, Li3InCl6, and Li3YCl6 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The lithium indium chloride shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 30% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more.

title: Lithium metal halide ion-conductive solid represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Hf(z)Br6
abstract: Provided is an orthorhombic halide ion-conductive solid in which erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of a close-packed chloride lattice. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. In the orthorhombic structure, erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed bromide sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. A halide coating is compatible with the ion-conductive solid because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. The LiF and Li3YCl6 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.15 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. After dehydration under vacuum at 200 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 1.2 mS/cm. A precursor of the LiF and Li3YCl6 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The disclosure is applicable to lithium fluoride (LiF) and Li3YCl6. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The hafnium substitution lowers the raw material cost of the rare earth halide and improves the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

assignee_db_group: DALANE UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 15 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 700 to 850 degrees C is described. A 15 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and scandia-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium niobium tantalum oxide and to a method for producing the same. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. Examples of the ion conductor include Li3InCl6. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. The material comprises Li3InCl6, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobium tantalum oxide, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The high coverage of the coating results in improved electrochemical window at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 330 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 15% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 4 stacked cells. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The warm isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Zirconium-substituted Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO ion-conductive solid stable above 4.5 V and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an ion-conductive solid whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The ion-conductive solid powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. Part of the titanium in the Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase is substituted by zirconium in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The LLTO material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 4.5 V. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the sinterability is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 100 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Lithium metal halide ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6 and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A halide ion conductor having the composition Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6, wherein z is 0.1 to 0.35, and a method for producing the same are provided. After dehydration under vacuum at 300 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LiF, Li3InCl6, and Li3YCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The orthorhombic phase is obtained by heat treatment at 300 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. The halide phase is free of a LiCl secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery.
