A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. Suitable compositions include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved moisture stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 2 hours is 55% or more.

title: Zirconium-substituted lithium erbium chloride solid electrolyte with orthorhombic structure and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A rare earth metal halide solid electrolyte with cation disorder and a hexachloride framework is described. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.2 to 0.45. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li3InCl6. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, ErCl3, and ZrCl4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.9 micrometers to 9 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3InCl6 material. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in a solid-state battery. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polyaniline doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The capacitor rated at 35 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The polyaniline is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite with a thickness of 8 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 470 microfarad rating. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 10 milliohms or less.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium difluorophosphate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The additive lithium difluorophosphate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. With 0.5 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ceramic ion conductor using a mother powder
abstract: A garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body having an average grain size of 5 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. Suitable compositions include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and beta-Li3PS4. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. In a lithium secondary battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. A lithium excess of 5 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The grain size is 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and the relative density is 91% or more after sintering at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the cycle life and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a relative density of 86% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 1000 degrees C to 1350 degrees C, and wherein 0.21 <= v <= 0.9.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a lanthanum fluoride solid electrolyte for detecting ammonia
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a gold electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the ammonia concentration. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The ceramic is lanthanum fluoride and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 500 degrees C. The sensor detects ammonia with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The limiting current is proportional to the ammonia concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting ammonia, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising gold disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 500 degrees C.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed bromine-iodine substitution and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. The material comprises Li7P3S11, wherein the argyrodite-type crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, bromine, and iodine. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiBr relative to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.12 or less. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less.

title: Lithium indium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li3InCl6 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. An argyrodite-type phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 20% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium indium chloride, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li3InCl6 and Li2ZrO3 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C.

title: Dendrite-suppressing indium additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell for lithium battery
abstract: A negative electrode structure with a critical current density of 0.7 mA/cm2 or more and a method for suppressing void formation during stripping are provided. The indium additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ceramic ion conductor powder. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. A Coulombic efficiency of 98.5% or more and a critical current density of 1 mA/cm2 are obtained at 25 degrees C. The material comprises Li3YCl6, and the electronic conductivity of the ceramic ion conductor layer is 1 x 10^-9 S/cm or less to prevent lithium deposition inside the layer. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. Because nucleation is uniform, the local current density is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.5% or more, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. With 3 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The additive lithium difluorophosphate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 3 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate is also described. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium difluorophosphate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The solid electrolyte layer of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 200 MPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, 1,3-propane sultone, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. With 0.5 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The additive 1,3-propane sultone reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The combination of 1,3-propane sultone and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A solid electrolyte sheet of 50 micrometers is used as the separator. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2WO4 shell with high coverage and lithium battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4) disposed on the surface of the core particles. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tungstate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. In an embodiment the material is lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li3InCl6. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The LiNbO3 and Li3InCl6 material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A coverage of 85% and a thickness of 8 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 40%. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.8 nm to 40 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more.

title: Bromine-substituted Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: A Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y) and a method for producing the same are described. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 9.6 mS/cm. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11 and beta-Li3PS4. A halide coating is compatible with the ion-conductive solid because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The material is useful as an ion-conductive solid layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1.3 <= a <= 1.7, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 7.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The cold isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Iodine-substituted Li6PS5X solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich Li6PS5X phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LGPS, Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11 material. Partial substitution of chlorine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. After ball milling, the solid electrolyte precursor is pressed and sintered. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The solid electrolyte is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The solid electrolyte provides improved cycle life compared with a single-halogen Li6PS5X of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein 1.3 <= a <= 1.7, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 0.35 <= y/a <= 0.65.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a platinum electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the carbon dioxide concentration. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to carbon dioxide against interfering gases. The protective layer improves the durability of the gadolinium-doped ceria sensor in an exhaust gas. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of carbon dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The ceramic is gadolinium-doped ceria and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 500 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of carbon dioxide.

title: aluminum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The polyaniline is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: Provided is an ion-conductive solid comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 50%. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is beta-Li3PS4, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 70:30, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The content of LiI is 3 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 320 degrees C, and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm or more. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the moisture stability is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 360 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by uniaxial pressing. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more during cycling is described. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 3 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate is also described. With 3 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type solid electrolyte and lithium battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide solid electrolyte having a cubic argyrodite-type structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. In a lithium secondary battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 6 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The argyrodite-type crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7P3S11. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. The solid electrolyte provides improved moisture stability compared with a single-halogen argyrodite-type of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less, and wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 330 degrees C to 580 degrees C.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Disclosed is a UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of yttrium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a halide ion-conductive solid in which hafnium is substituted for part of the yttrium in a lithium yttrium bromide framework. The material comprises Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF), and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The electrode mixture of the all-solid-state battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The ion-conductive component may be Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF). A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved ionic conductivity and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.1 <= z <= 0.35.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 80% at 25 degrees C. The carbon coating on the nickel sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. The cathode delivering 600 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The uniaxial pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises sulfur impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The sulfur cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The sulfur is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising graphene; sulfur impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li2WO4 and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li2WO4 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. A solid-state battery comprising the LiNbO3 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tungstate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LiNbO3 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 5 nm. The solid electrolyte may comprise lithium niobate (LiNbO3). In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 70 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 2 nm to 10 nm.

title: Mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of yttrium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of yttrium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.5 V. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LiF, Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and Li6PS5Cl material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.5 V versus Li/Li+. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. A coating layer of the halide on the active material lowers the interfacial resistance with the sulfide, and the coverage is determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The ceramic ion conductor can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the solid-state lithium battery. The monoclinic phase is obtained by heat treatment at 350 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. The halide ceramic ion conductor is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing vinylene carbonate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and carboxymethyl cellulose binder
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose is described. The active material is coated with a thin lithium phosphosulfide ion conductor layer so that the cathode can be used in a solid-state cell. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into porous carbon at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The confinement of lithium sulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. Polysulfide dissolution from the lithium sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The cathode delivering 1200 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the Li6PS5X family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. A dry process is preferred for forming the ceramic ion conductor sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The disclosure is applicable to lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer. The Li2ZrO3 and LATP material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. A mixed-halogen Li6PS5X phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 550 degrees C. The mixed halogen substitution improves the grain boundary resistance and ionic conductivity of the all-solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 680 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.3 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid having a soft-acid surface region
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid tin binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -40 degrees C and the exposure time is 6 hours. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the ion-conductive solid is improved. Specific examples are Li7P3S11. The substitution amount is 8 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C, and the conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm or more. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the grain boundary resistance are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of scandium and titanium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a halide ion-conductive solid in which titanium is substituted for part of the scandium in a lithium scandium chloride framework. The ion-conductive component may be lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3YCl6, and Li3InCl6. The halide is applied to the positive electrode active material by a wet coating with an alkoxide-free solution, giving a coated cathode. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The median particle diameter D50 is 2 micrometers and the pellet conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm after pressing at 300 MPa. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.6 micrometers to 6 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and a conductive agent.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained.
