The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers. Specific examples are Li3InCl6. The coated particles are heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 75 mol% or more of the transition metals. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide solid electrolyte. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the cycle life and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 35% or more.

title: Bromine-substituted Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.12 or less. The Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. Firing is performed at 450 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the electrochemical window of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.35 <= y/a <= 0.65, and wherein 1.2 <= a <= 1.6, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 6.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of indium and titanium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a halide ceramic ion conductor in which titanium is substituted for part of the indium in a lithium indium bromide framework. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li3YCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A halide coating is compatible with the ceramic ion conductor because both are stable against oxidation above 4 V. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. When z is 0.3, the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm and the electrochemical window extends to 4.5 V. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. In the trigonal structure, indium and titanium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed bromide sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which indium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.7, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet comprises ceramic ion conductor particles and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network that binds the particles without a solvent. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LATP and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The ion-conductive component may be Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 80 degrees C to form a continuous film. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The sheet has a thickness of 80 micrometers, a porosity of 15%, a tensile strength of 1 MPa, and an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. The fibrillated binder gives a flexible sheet and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.3 MPa or more, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 60% or less, and wherein the free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet has a roll temperature of 20 degrees C to 160 degrees C.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 92% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. Sintering is performed at 1230 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and beta-Li3PS4. The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1230 degrees C, and the resulting density is 92%. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the ionic conductivity of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1030 degrees C to 1380 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 0.5 micrometers to 30 micrometers, and wherein 0.06 <= v <= 0.75.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 47 microfarad rating. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 15 milliohms at 100 kHz. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 10 V.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region and method for preparing the same
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid tin binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 3.2 mS/cm. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. A precursor of the LLZO material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the sinterability are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 6 hours is 45% or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 15 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The capacitor has a capacitance of 220 microfarads, a rated voltage of 16 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 15 milliohms at 100 kHz. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The capacity retention of 90% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Lithium metal halide ion-conductive solid represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6
abstract: A halide ion conductor having the composition Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6, wherein z is 0.1 to 0.35, and a method for producing the same are provided. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. Heat treatment at 300 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a monoclinic phase with a conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm or more. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. In an embodiment the material is lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3InCl6, and Li3YCl6. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, YCl3, and HfCl4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.6, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 420 degrees C, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate is also described. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. With 1 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The capacity retention of 88% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without vinylene carbonate. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The 1.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria with a thickness of 5 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of samarium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 100 microfarad rating. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 5 milliohms or less.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The capacitor rated at 25 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polyaniline particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The uniaxial pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic LiPON layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: A lithium metal negative electrode having a protective layer with a thickness of 80 nm to 400 nm and a lithium metal battery including the same are provided. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. The inorganic layer is formed by sputtering to a thickness of 80 nm to 400 nm and has an ionic conductivity of 5 x 10^-6 S/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The ion-conductive component may be beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and lithium fluoride (LiF). The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 5 x 10^-6 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 99.5% after 100 cycles. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the dendrite suppression and cycle life of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium phosphorus oxynitride (LiPON) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 3 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 650 to 800 degrees C is described. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a zinc-containing additive layer
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor comprises a lithium metal layer, a ceramic ion conductor layer, and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the all-solid-state battery. The cell shows no short circuit for 300 cycles at 1 mA/cm2 and 1 mAh/cm2 under a stack pressure of 10 MPa. The method prevents short circuit and improves the ionic conductivity without a thick protective layer.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the content of the zinc additive is 0.2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.5% or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium indium chloride coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium indium chloride and to a method for producing the same. A halide coating layer may be used together with the solid electrolyte to improve the cycle life of the solid-state lithium battery. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the LiNbO3, Li2ZrO3, and Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A coverage of 85% and a thickness of 15 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 40%. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 75 mol% or more of the transition metals. A solid-state lithium battery using the coated active material shows improved interfacial resistance and cycle life and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 55 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 15% or more.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. An ionic conductivity of 2.6 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.3 to 0.75. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite-type shows a higher conductivity and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.15 <= x <= 0.95, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive in an amount of 2 wt%. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 2 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate is also described. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. With 2 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: A negative electrode structure with a critical current density of 2.1 mA/cm2 or more and a method for suppressing void formation during stripping are provided. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. In an embodiment the ion-conductive solid layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium fluoride (LiF), and Li3YCl6. The additive content is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, the stack pressure is 1 MPa to 4 MPa, and the critical current density is 3 mA/cm2. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium fluoride (LiF), and Li3YCl6, and the electronic conductivity of the ion-conductive solid layer is 1 x 10^-9 S/cm or less to prevent lithium deposition inside the layer. Lithium penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed because the nucleation is uniform and the current density is below the critical value. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising lithium fluoride dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 200 cycles or more, and wherein the content of the lithium fluoride additive is 0.1 wt% to 5 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 97.5% or more.

title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a zinc-containing additive layer
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor comprises a lithium metal layer, a ceramic ion conductor layer, and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. The additive layer has a thickness of 0.5 micrometers to 5 micrometers and is lithiophilic. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The plating overpotential is 30 mV or less and the Coulombic efficiency is 99% after 100 cycles. A stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. The Li3PS4 and LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The method prevents short circuit and improves the ionic conductivity without a thick protective layer.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 0.4 MPa to 10 MPa, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 200 cycles or more, and wherein the content of the zinc additive is 0.5 wt% to 25 wt%.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The roll pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with low residual solvent for lithium battery
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor by stirring the raw materials in ethyl acetate at 80 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and a conductivity of 4.1 mS/cm. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The solvent is ethyl acetate, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11 material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the grain boundary resistance of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 1 wt% to 60 wt%, and wherein the reaction temperature is 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: A lithium metal interface with uniform nucleation and suppressed dendrite penetration along grain boundaries is described. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The argyrodite-type phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. A Coulombic efficiency of 98.8% or more and a critical current density of 3 mA/cm2 are obtained at 25 degrees C. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The magnesium additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. The ion-conductive component may be lithium fluoride (LiF). An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The additive suppresses lithium dendrites and improves the dendrite suppression of the solid-state cell.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising magnesium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the content of the magnesium additive is 0.2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 2 MPa to 50 MPa.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor withstands 150 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 16 V.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a high-voltage stable oxide ion conductor based on Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO and a method for forming its oxidation-resistant surface. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The disclosure is applicable to Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. After ball milling, the solid electrolyte precursor is pressed and sintered. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 5 V. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The widened electrochemical window improves the sinterability and ionic conductivity of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.4 V or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 500 to 650 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Hafnium-substituted lithium scandium bromide ceramic ion conductor with trigonal structure and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Provided is a trigonal halide ceramic ion conductor in which scandium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of a close-packed chloride lattice. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The trigonal phase is obtained by heat treatment at 250 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. The halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.5 V versus Li/Li+. The hafnium substitution in an amount z of 0.1 to 0.35 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. Also described is an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the all-solid-state lithium battery. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which scandium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 130 degrees C to 370 degrees C, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Provided is a sulfide ion-conductive solid that retains 80% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. The LLZO and Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. After exposure to air with a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours, the conductivity retention is 90%. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a silicon substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Halogen-rich Li6PS5X ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder
abstract: This disclosure provides a Li6PS5X ceramic ion conductor whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The ceramic ion conductor exhibits an ionic conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. Suitable compositions include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 8.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyethylene oxide. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet solid electrolyte doped with aluminum and sintered with Li3BO3 is described. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. Sintering is performed at 1150 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The mother powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers, and the sintered body has a conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the high-voltage stability. A sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 10 mol% to 30 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.24 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 89% or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The capacity retention of 88% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: titanium disulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The carbon coating on the titanium disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The titanium disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The confinement of titanium disulfide in the ketjen black suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising ketjen black; titanium disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. A capacitance of 100 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 5 milliohms or less.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and lithium battery
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28 and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated therein. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li3InCl6. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 4 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 30% to 65% by X-ray diffraction. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the interfacial resistance and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 170 degrees C to 360 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 10% to 100%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polyaniline layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous niobium anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polyaniline doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 10 V.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Potentiometric sulfur dioxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 500 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Lithium fluoride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: A method for forming a protective layer on lithium metal by sputtering followed by solution coating of a polymer is described. A cell with the protected lithium metal negative electrode operates for 200 cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li3YCl6. The bilayer structure improves the dendrite suppression compared with a single inorganic layer.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.05 micrometers to 5 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 20 nm to 1200 nm.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a lanthanum fluoride solid electrolyte for detecting carbon dioxide
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 700 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The sensor detects carbon dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of carbon dioxide.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. With 3 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
