title: Slurry composition for a ceramic ion conductor layer using a nonpolar solvent and hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber
abstract: Described is a slurry composition using a nonpolar solvent that does not react with the sulfide and a binder soluble in the solvent. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4. The slurry has a solid content of 50 wt% and a viscosity of 3000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, and the dried layer has a thickness of 20 micrometers and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. The mixture for the ceramic ion conductor is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The controlled viscosity gives a uniform thickness and improved cycle life and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the solid content of the slurry is 25 wt% to 70 wt%, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 300 mPa s to 15000 mPa s, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.3 wt% to 15 wt%.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 35 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A lithium battery pack comprising 2 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The warm isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The niobium capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. With 0.5 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of yttrium and zirconium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Described is a lithium yttrium chloride ceramic ion conductor prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 3 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.3 to 0.55. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. The material comprises Li3YCl6, Li3InCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF), and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. Specific examples are Li3YCl6, Li3InCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF). The Li3YCl6, Li3InCl6, and LiF material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.8, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more.

title: Lithium tantalate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based solid-state battery is described. The coating layer has an average thickness of 3 nm and a coverage of 95%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 50% relative to uncoated particles. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. The raw materials of the ceramic ion conductor are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. In an embodiment the material is Li3InCl6 and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 25% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 30 mol% or more.

title: Method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. Heat treatment at 550 degrees C after drying at 150 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm or more. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. The low electronic conductivity of the Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5Cl material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The suspension has a solid concentration of 7.5 wt% to 30 wt% and is reacted at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 3 wt% or less.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 15 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The capacitor withstands 150 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Tin-substituted perovskite-type LLTO ion-conductive solid stable above 5 V and method for producing the same
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid that remains stable up to 5 V and a lithium battery with a high-voltage cathode are provided. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. Suitable compositions include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 5 V. The low electronic conductivity of the Li6PS5Cl material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the moisture stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 65% or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. With 3 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. With 2 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium difluorophosphate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid and to a lithium battery including the same. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3 and LLZO material. A Li6PS5X phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The dopant aluminum occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The grain size is 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and the relative density is 92% or more after sintering at 1020 degrees C to 1170 degrees C. The method gives reproducible densification and improved high-voltage stability and sinterability at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 900 degrees C to 1250 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.24 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 87% or more.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria with a thickness of 15 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using tetrahydrofuran for lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with a residual solvent content of 0.5 wt% or less. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The powder is formed into a sheet by kneading with a fibrillated PTFE binder and roll-pressing without a solvent to a thickness of 30 micrometers to 80 micrometers. The solid electrolyte obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 0.5 wt%. The low electronic conductivity of the Li6PS5Cl, Li3PS4, LLZO, and LATP material makes it suitable for use in contact with a lithium metal anode. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1.5 wt% or less.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes for lithium battery
abstract: A NASICON-type or perovskite-type oxide ion-conductive solid with an oxidation limit of 4.7 V or more is described. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li3YCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The oxidation potential is 5 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The material is useful as a catholyte in a high-voltage positive electrode mixture, with improved cycle life and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The capacity retention of 90% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% with the electrolyte. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium bis(oxalato)borate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A glassy sulfide solid electrolyte with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 80:20, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 80%. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved ionic conductivity and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 100%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 420 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. The suspension has a solid concentration of 2.5 wt% to 10 wt% and is reacted at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The material comprises Li7P3S11 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. Also described is an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm or more. An argyrodite-type phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The method does not require long mechanical milling and gives an ion-conductive solid with improved moisture stability and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 250 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 1 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1.5 wt% or less.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid that remains stable up to 4.8 V and a lithium battery with a high-voltage cathode are provided. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.3 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 4.8 V. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The lithium secondary battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ion-conductive solid layer. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 70% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 25 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite-type family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.1 <= y/a <= 0.6, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 1.2 <= a <= 2.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The 1.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 3 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Composite cathode comprising lithium sulfide and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride is described. The active material lithium sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Composite cathode comprising nickel sulfide and porous carbon and lithium secondary battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. Polysulfide dissolution from the nickel sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The carbon coating on the nickel sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The confinement of nickel sulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; nickel sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The capacitor has a capacitance of 220 microfarads, a rated voltage of 16 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 15 milliohms at 100 kHz. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium difluorophosphate. The additive lithium difluorophosphate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Self-supporting solid electrolyte sheet having low porosity and method for calendering the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a roll-pressing method for forming a solid electrolyte film without any solvent. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The LATP, LLZO, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. The tensile strength is 0.3 MPa or more and the elongation at break is 5% or more. The synthesis comprises reacting the raw materials in a suspension with stirring and removing the residual solvent before the sheet is formed. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LATP, LLZO, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl material. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The low porosity results in a low areal resistance and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the thickness of the sheet is 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid with low residual solvent and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. A dry process in which the ion-conductive solid powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the lithium secondary battery. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LLZO, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. The reaction at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid obtained by the method shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant niobium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. Sintering is performed at 1230 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. Sintering at 1230 degrees C with a lithium excess of 15 mol% gives a relative density of 95% and a conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1150 degrees C to 1300 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 87% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.24 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 10 mol% to 30 mol%.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. With 2 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and vinylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A glassy sulfide ion-conductive solid with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The ion-conductive solid may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is thio-LISICON, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the ion-conductive solid is improved. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or thio-LISICON phase precipitates uniformly. The content of P2O5 is 8 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 260 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.8 mS/cm or more. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the moisture stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 40 hours.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite-type structure with controlled halogen occupancy for lithium battery
abstract: An ion-conductive solid comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and iodine. The LLZO and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. When fired at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 3.8 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. A solid-state lithium battery using the ion-conductive solid in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.25 <= x <= 1.05.

title: Tungsten-doped garnet solid electrolyte sintered body with high relative density and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte and to a lithium battery including the same. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LATP, LLTO, and Li2ZrO3 material. The dopant tungsten occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.1 to 0.45, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1100 degrees C shows a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm and a relative density of 94%. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 900 degrees C to 1250 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 1 micrometers to 60 micrometers.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2WO4 shell with high coverage and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 80% or more and an average thickness of 2 nm to 10 nm is provided. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li3InCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide solid electrolyte. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. The lithium tungstate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the interfacial resistance and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.5 nm to 25 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. Polysulfide dissolution from the sulfur cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of sulfur. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The sulfur is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The titanium disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. The titanium disulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising ketjen black; titanium disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a thio-LISICON phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing LiI. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 280 degrees C. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LGPS, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The precipitated thio-LISICON phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 20% to 100%, and wherein the content of LiI is 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polypyrrole layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. A capacitance of 330 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 330 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Lithium metal halide ion-conductive solid represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6 and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A halide ion conductor having the composition Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6, wherein z is 0.1 to 0.35, and a method for producing the same are provided. The oxidation stability limit is 4.1 V or more and the conductivity is 1.47 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The disclosure is applicable to Li3YCl6 and Li3InCl6. In the orthorhombic structure, erbium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The halide ion-conductive solid is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.8 V or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.6.

title: Air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid having a soft-acid surface region
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sulfide ion conductor with suppressed H2S generation and a method for producing the same. The substitution amount is 5 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 550 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.6 mS/cm or more. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 4 cm3/g or less. The ion-conductive solid may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. A solid-state battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a silicon substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 6 hours is 55% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.9 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6 and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A halide solid electrolyte comprises a trigonal crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6. The Li3YCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The trigonal phase is obtained by heat treatment at 300 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. In the trigonal structure, indium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li3YCl6. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved electrochemical window and rate capability.
first_claim: 1.
