Partial substitution of bromine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiBr impurity phase. An ionic conductivity of 6.4 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.4 to 0.85. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ceramic ion conductor in the solid-state lithium battery. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, bromine, and iodine. The ceramic ion conductor powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers. The ceramic ion conductor provides improved electrochemical window compared with a single-halogen argyrodite of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 6.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY Co., Ltd.
title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiTaO3 shell with high coverage and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium tantalate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. The coated particles are heat-treated at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The samarium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and to a solid-state battery comprising the same. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The ion-conductive solid exhibits an ionic conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The LGPS, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the solid-state battery. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein 0.25 <= x <= 1.05, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 360 degrees C to 610 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.3 or less.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyethylene oxide matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a plasticizer. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyethylene oxide matrix. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Halide solid electrolyte having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: A halide solid electrolyte comprises an orthorhombic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6. The halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.2 V versus Li/Li+. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The zirconium substitution in an amount z of 0.3 to 0.55 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. In a solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The zirconium substitution lowers the raw material cost of the rare earth halide and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.8, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 130 degrees C to 370 degrees C.

title: Potentiometric oxygen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a platinum electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the oxygen concentration. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 700 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the oxygen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid and to a lithium battery including the same. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The grain size is 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and the relative density is 91% or more after sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C. Sintering is performed at 1150 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The ion-conductive solid powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The ion-conductive solid can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state lithium battery. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4. The method gives reproducible densification and improved cycle life at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 10 mol% to 30 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.24 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 86% or more.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 700 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The limiting current is proportional to the hydrogen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which ammonia is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The sensor shows a response time of 5 seconds to a step change of ammonia concentration at 700 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The ceramic is lanthanum fluoride and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 700 degrees C. The sensor detects ammonia with high selectivity and a response time of 5 seconds.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising barium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects ammonia.

title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic Ag-C layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an artificial interphase formed on a lithium metal negative electrode by thermal evaporation. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and lithium fluoride (LiF). The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. After ball milling, the solid electrolyte precursor is pressed and sintered. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. In a lithium secondary battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. A cell with the protected lithium metal negative electrode operates for 200 cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 500 nm. The polymer layer keeps the contact during volume change and improves the cycle life and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising silver-carbon composite (Ag-C) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 50 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 50 nm to 3000 nm, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.05 micrometers to 5 micrometers.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2ZrO3 shell with high coverage and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based solid-state lithium battery is described. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The average thickness of the coating is 4 nm to 20 nm, the coverage is 75% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The LiNbO3 and Li3InCl6 material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li3InCl6. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The lithium zirconate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 330 degrees C to 600 degrees C.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiNb(1-z)TazO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The Li2ZrO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobium tantalum oxide, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. Specific examples are lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The average thickness of the coating is 6 nm to 30 nm, the coverage is 80% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C. The lithium niobium tantalum oxide shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.5 nm to 75 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 35% or more.

title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic LiF layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode comprises an inorganic layer of lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer. The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 1 x 10^-5 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 99% after 100 cycles. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 100 nm. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li3YCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Specific examples are Li3YCl6. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. A precursor of the Li3YCl6 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The lithiophilic interphase gives uniform lithium deposition and improved ionic conductivity and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 125 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.05 micrometers to 5 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 10 nm to 600 nm.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which molybdenum disulfide is confined in the pores of carbon nanotubes to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The cathode delivering 600 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The molybdenum disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with carbon nanotubes by ball milling. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the molybdenum disulfide cathode. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising carbon nanotubes; molybdenum disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6 and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed chloride anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The composition forms a shell on the cathode particles that suppresses the space-charge layer, so that the halide serves as the coating layer. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. Heat treatment at 300 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a trigonal phase with a conductivity of 0.56 mS/cm or more. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, InCl3, and ZrCl4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The electrode mixture of the solid-state battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which indium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.5, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.8 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 420 degrees C.

title: Self-supporting solid electrolyte sheet having low porosity and method for calendering the same
abstract: Disclosed is a solvent-free method of forming a solid electrolyte sheet by kneading the powder with PTFE under shear and rolling the mixture between heated rollers. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the solid electrolyte layer onto an electrode of the all-solid-state battery without a drying step. The binder is polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) in an amount of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%, and the fibrils have an average diameter of 50 nm to 500 nm. Examples of the ion conductor include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), beta-Li3PS4, and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. An all-solid-state battery using a lithium metal anode together with the solid electrolyte shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LATP, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The roll temperature is 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C and the sheet has a thickness of 20 micrometers after calendering. The kneaded mixture is rolled between rollers at 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C, and the roller gap is reduced stepwise in at least three passes. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. An all-solid-state battery using the sheet shows improved sheet formability and a thinner electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.3 MPa or more, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 10 V.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The uniaxial pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 75% or more and an average thickness of 6 nm to 30 nm is provided. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 80 mol% or more of the transition metals. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Nickel accounts for 90 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 300 degrees C. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium niobium tantalum oxide, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A lithium secondary battery using the coated active material shows improved electrochemical window and high-voltage stability and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.5 nm to 75 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium iron phosphate, and a conductive agent. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfur cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The carbon coating on the sulfur composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of sulfur. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, porous carbon, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 5 milliohms or less.

title: Zirconium-substituted lithium yttrium chloride solid electrolyte with orthorhombic structure and production method thereof
abstract: Described is a lithium yttrium chloride solid electrolyte prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. A halogen-rich argyrodite-type with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. The halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.2 V versus Li/Li+. The zirconium substitution in an amount z of 0.02 to 0.25 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The solid electrolyte is preferably lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3YCl6, and Li3InCl6. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. In the orthorhombic structure, yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.5, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 470 degrees C.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. With 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises lithium sulfide impregnated in porous carbon and a carbon coating on the composite. The confinement of lithium sulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. A separator coated with porous carbon traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. The active material lithium sulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 3 mg/cm2. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Lithium niobate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium niobate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 8 nm. The ceramic ion conductor powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. After ball milling, the ceramic ion conductor precursor is pressed and sintered. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The coated particles are heat-treated at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. An all-solid-state battery using the coated active material shows improved high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 60% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.8 nm to 40 nm.

title: Halide ceramic ion conductor having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: Described is a lithium scandium chloride ceramic ion conductor prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. Heat treatment at 350 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a monoclinic phase with a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm or more. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3InCl6 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.15 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material comprises Li3InCl6, and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The ion-conductive component may be Li3InCl6. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which scandium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0 <= z <= 0.6, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and carboxymethyl cellulose binder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfur cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The active material is coated with a thin lithium phosphosulfide ion conductor layer so that the cathode can be used in a solid-state cell. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the sulfur cathode. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. Polysulfide dissolution from the sulfur cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The confinement of sulfur in the ketjen black suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, ketjen black, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 2 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ion-conductive solid with reduced grain boundary resistance for lithium battery
abstract: A garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body having an average grain size of 2 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. A sintering aid comprising Al2O3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. Sintering is performed at 1230 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The sintered body has a relative density of 94%, an average grain size of 2 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The all-solid-state lithium battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ion-conductive solid layer. The ion-conductive solid powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The method gives reproducible densification and improved high-voltage stability at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.01 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 86% or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 98%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type solid electrolyte having anion disorder for lithium battery
abstract: An argyrodite-type solid electrolyte represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y) and a method for producing the same are described. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.03, and the room-temperature conductivity is 7.3 mS/cm. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite-type shows a higher conductivity and better cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1 <= a <= 1.8, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid having a soft-acid surface region and method for preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ion-conductive solid whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 40 cm3/g or less. An argyrodite-type sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. A coating layer of the halide on the active material lowers the interfacial resistance with the sulfide, and the coverage is determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The material comprises Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 40 cm3/g or less. Specific examples are Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -20 degrees C and the exposure time is 6 hours. After exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours, the conductivity retention is 70%. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 100 cm3/g or less.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 500 degrees C. The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 380 degrees C to 630 degrees C.

assignee_db_group: DALANE UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an artificial interphase formed on a lithium metal negative electrode by thermal evaporation. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The resulting Li3YCl6 and LLZO material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The LiF layer of 500 nm lowers the interfacial resistance to 20 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the dendrite suppression and ionic conductivity of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 50 cycles or more, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 50 nm to 3000 nm.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Bromine-substituted Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: An ion-conductive solid comprising a crystal phase of the Li6PS5X type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. Firing is performed at 520 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The LGPS, Li7P3S11, and Li3PS4 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.075 or less. The material is useful as an ion-conductive solid layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less.

title: Ceramic ion conductor slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer comprises ceramic ion conductor particles, a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder, a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved, and a dispersant. The binder is hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber in an amount of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt% and is dissolved in the nonpolar solvent heptane. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. The binder is a rubber that keeps the layer flexible after drying and does not block the ion conduction between particles. The powder is synthesized by a liquid-phase route in which the raw materials are dissolved in a solvent, precipitated, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 550 degrees C. The solid content is 50 wt% to 70 wt%, the viscosity is 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s, and the layer thickness is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The wet process is useful for forming a layer on a large area, with improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 50 mPa s to 2500 mPa s, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The sensor detects oxygen with high selectivity and a response time of 5 seconds. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the oxygen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polycarbonate and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The roll pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 300 MPa. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 30 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyethylene oxide; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid is described. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The active material sulfur is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. Polysulfide dissolution from the sulfur cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The composite shows a capacity of 1200 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The confinement of nickel sulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the nickel sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; nickel sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polycarbonate and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite-type solid electrolyte and lithium battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite-type solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-iodine substitution. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.12 or less. Specific examples are Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The material comprises Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), wherein the argyrodite-type crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and iodine. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. An ionic conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 1.3 to 1.7. The material is useful as a solid electrolyte layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1.
